Class TrustedReviewerList

java.lang.Object
application.TrustedReviewerList
public class TrustedReviewerList extends Object

The TrustedReviewerList class manages a collection of trusted reviewers and their corresponding trust weights. This can be used to track reviewer reliability, reputation, or ranking within a system.

Internally, it stores reviewer names and their trust values using a HashMap. Each reviewer is associated with an integer weight that can be retrieved, updated, or removed.
